title: Introducing Lob's No-Code Design Suite
summary: Personalized direct mail is easier with Lob's No-Code Design Suite. Create templates, map dynamic fields, and launch campaigns — no coding required.
body_markdown:
Personalization is one of the most effective ways to build relevance and lift direct mail results, but it’s often easier said than done.


Personalizing mail requires extra time, tools, and technical know-how. It adds a layer of complexity to an already demanding workflow, leading many mailers to settle for less targeted campaigns, or even skip personalization altogether.


Getting personalized mail into production – at scale and on schedule – can be a challenge, *but it doesn’t have to be.*


## **A new way to create personalized direct mail**


Now you can bring your creative to life without code.[Lob’s No-Code Design Suite](https://www.lob.com/no-code) , brings pro-level mail personalization without the technical bottlenecks.


With the powerful No-Code Design Suite, you can move from approved concept to completion all in one workflow. Dynamic field mapping, intuitive visual editing, and a production-ready template library make it easier than ever to launch personalized direct mail campaigns at the speed of digital.


The highlights:


**Create and update templates with ease**


The Visual Editor has everything you need to start designing personalized, production-ready mail from the tools you already use. Convert existing[InDesign](https://www.lob.com/integration/indesign) and[Figma](https://www.lob.com/integration/figma) layouts into a Lob template with a click. Edit and personalize copy, imagery, and offers directly within Lob. Or create a new template from scratch. Personalized mail performs best when it's built into how you already send, not bolted on as an extra step. For teams running automated, recurring mail programs, the No-Code Design Suite means every merge variable, image, and offer can be personalized without adding engineering time to the roadmap. Your team edits copy and creative directly in Lob, so personalization scales with your program instead of becoming a bottleneck to it.


**Build consistency across every campaign**


The Design Library puts all of your assets, including fonts and images, in one centralized place. So you can quickly reuse approved assets across your entire template library, maintain brand consistency, and keep your campaigns on track.


With the No-Code Design Suite, last-minute updates are no longer a headache. Simply make the changes you need directly in Lob and they update everywhere, automatically.


**Personalize like a pro**


Whether you’re a designer, marketer, or developer, the No-Code Design Suite offers streamlined workflows with fewer handoffs. Now, your entire team can launch personalized campaigns faster, collaborate easier, and spend less time troubleshooting issues. Everyone wins.


## **The future of direct mail personalization is here**


Advanced personalization is the future of direct mail marketing. Lob’s No-Code Design Suite makes it possible – faster, easier, and more scalable than ever before. Without technical barriers, you don’t have to choose between personalization and practicality.


Bring personalized campaigns into production with the same flexibility and efficiency as the rest of your marketing stack.
